parties.respondent: State Rep. By Inspector Of Police

summary: Conviction under IPC s.302 based on dying declaration; multiple inconsistent statements by deceased (initially accidental, later implicating appellant); first statements to doctor and police indicated kitchen accident; subsequent dying declaration before Judicial Magistrate implicated appellant; explanation for delay—that husband was present—not corroborated; Judicial Magistrate did not inquire into prior statements; no independent evidence of assault or kerosene use; post-mortem showed only burn injuries; prosecution witnesses contradicted each other, some declared hostile; lack of corroboration renders dying declaration unreliable; mechanical reliance by Trial Court and High Court improper.
legal_provisions_cited: Uttam v. State of Maharashtra (2022) 8 SCC 576
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted.
